title.narrative: Enterprise development for Ukraine - Fenix Repower AS / Provision of stable power from renewable energy

description.narrative:
The Project’s expected effect(s) on society is to increase generation of and access to stable power in Ukraine. The aim is to facilitate a specific wind power project in Ukraine collocated with BESS (Battery energy storage system) as well as further BESS projects around the country (Impact).
The Project’s expected effect(s) for the target groups is to improve the access to stable power for the population, as well as to improve the framework conditions of developers of BESS more broadly (Outcome). The planned main outputs of the Project in this phase is to document the feasibility of a wind/BESS plant in Ukraine (e.g. by conducting a financial, technical modelling), and to map out the barriers to broader adoption of battery systems in Ukraine in order to better inform regulatory and policy decisions (Outputs). The project will have a high degree of transferability also to solar/BESS solutions.
The intended target groups are the electricity consumers of Ukraine, and the distributed renewable sector, including both developers and investors as well as regulators and policy makers.
